description: Persist canonical enumeration terms/distractors and implement shared metadata, identity, quota, privacy, and session persistence contracts.
steps: Extend QuizQuestion and DTOs, validate fields, add nullable JSONB columns to sql/schema.sql, and update Neon, Supabase, Memory, LocalFirst, Cached, and public projection mappings.
Implement getAnswerIdentityKey, getEnumerationMetadata, pure enumeration state/attempt/option utilities, and preserve numeric getQuestionAnswer semantics.
Extend useQuizSession with submitEnumerationTerm/selectEnumerationOption and exact quota-completion transition boundary; add presentation-keyed version-2 snapshot persistence.
Add repository, utility, hook, persistence, API, and privacy tests for empty options, malformed values, duplicate identity, quota mismatch, restore, retry, and hidden payload/markup.
acceptance_criteria: Empty-option enumeration with answer_text 3 and answer_terms A/B/C round-trips through create/update/repositories.
Intermediate enumeration attempts do not invoke ordinary mastery transition; exactly one transition occurs at quota completion.
Missing/null, valid-empty, malformed, insufficient, and quota-mismatch states are deterministic and tested.
Hidden public/shared projections omit answer_terms and enumeration_distractors and do not leak them in rendered output.
